description: Search live marketplace listings by GPU model, minimum VRAM, region, host reputation, and current verification (verified_only), sorted by price, reputation, region, or VRAM. Each offer carries its host's evidence: verification (verified, overdue, deverified, unverified) with the last and next check, the latest xcelsior-bench run (date, version, verdict, fp16 TFLOPS, memory bandwidth, allocatable VRAM, peak temperature and thermal-throttle share under sustained load), reputation tier and score, and the 30-day job success rate (runs not ended by a host fault). price_per_hour_cad is the price a launch is billed; ask_cents_per_hour is the host's own ask. Use when the user has a constraint to satisfy — a region, a VRAM floor, a trusted host — or wants to compare hosts. Read-only and free. Listings belong to independent hosts and change without notice.

verified_only.description: Only hosts whose verification is current
